name: Exa Agent
desc: One API call that runs multi-step web research for you.
desc_zh: 一次接口调用就能替你跑完多步网页检索
solves: Chaining search calls by hand means writing the loop, the retries and the citations. Exa Agent takes a plain-language goal and returns structured results with the proof attached.
solves_zh: 自己串检索调用，就得手写循环、重试和引用。Exa Agent 接收一句自然语言目标，返回带出处链接的结构化结果。
best_for: You need fifty companies checked against a written criteria and nobody has time to do it by hand.
best_for_zh: 你要按一段书面条件核查五十家公司，而没人有空手工去做。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://exa.ai/blog and https://exa.ai/docs/changelog , then https://exa.ai/）。 Launched 2026-06-16. The docs describe it as running 'multi-step web research, list-building, and enrichment workflows with natural-language answers, structured outputs, and citations'. Distinct from the ledger's Exa search API. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://exa.ai/blog/exa-agent
